about: Output tokens one member writes per hour it is active, measured on a 10-member fleet of Claude Code desktop sessions (one transcript per member, each model message counted once by its id, active time = gaps between transcript events of at most 5 minutes). Effort factors and the Haiku rates are estimates scaled from those measurements, not measured.
measuredOn: on 2026-11-01 from a 10-member fleet over about 3 hours: 8 Opus at high effort, 2 Sonnet at medium
